name: floating-ink
description: Work with Claude inside Floating Ink, the word processor from floatingrotations.com: Claude reads, writes and edits your documents, and builds presentations, while you watch.
long_description: Open Floating Ink (https://floatingrotations.com/ink/), click the robot button at the top and turn on "Connect AI". Then ask Claude to write, fix or summarize your documents. Every change shows up live and can be undone with Ctrl+Z. The documents stay in your browser; Claude only sees what it reads through these tools.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the documents and presentations in Floating Ink

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a document, and the text selected in it, or a presentation

tools.name: create_presentation
tools.description: Build a new presentation while you watch

tools.name: edit_presentation
tools.description: Add, change, delete or move slides, or change the colors

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new document and open it

tools.name: write_in_document
tools.description: Add text to a document, or replace the selected text

tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Replace a word or phrase everywhere in a document

tools.name: replace_document
tools.description: Rewrite a whole document (the old one is kept as a version)

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Leave a message in the Floating Ink chat panel

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read the messages in the Floating Ink chat panel

tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Listen to the chat panel and answer the moment the user writes
